name: What are the common types of roofing materials available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What are the common types of roofing materials available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common roofing materials for residential replacement include asphalt shingles, metal roofing, and tile. Asphalt shingles are popular for their cost-effectiveness and versatility, while metal roofs offer durability and longevity. Tile roofs provide a distinct aesthetic and excellent lifespan. The best choice often depends on your budget, desired aesthetic, local climate, and the architectural style of your home.
